### Migrate Evidence model backends to TensorRT

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.inference.model-migrations/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.inference.universal-tensorrt-integration/1`

Migrate OCR, clock OCR, SigLIP, YOLO, Whisper and Qwen to the broker in that order, proving parity and removing each superseded live Evidence backend after its gate passes.

### Build the universal TensorRT broker

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.inference.tensorrt-broker/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.inference.universal-tensorrt-integration/1`

Add a safe Rust broker/client contract and specialized native TensorRT and TensorRT-LLM workers with versioned local IPC, checksummed model packs, fail-closed execution and bounded GPU residency.

### Package and probe the Windows NVIDIA runtime

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.inference.windows-package/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.inference.universal-tensorrt-integration/1`

Package the broker, workers, model manifests and doctor probes for the Windows NVIDIA deployment, with per-user engine caching and no Python inference runtime.

## Unparented

### Choose the visual finder model by local body-camera retrieval recall

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.video.real-embedding-benchmark/1`

Implement the existing embed-cli contract with a fully local text-image encoder and compare real models on human-labeled original-timeline intervals from representative body-camera footage. Measure the sampler's opportunity to see each interval separately from the encoder's ability to retrieve it. Select and pin one exact model revision, preprocessing contract, embedding dimension and local runtime only after measuring interval recall, later-timeline coverage, indexing throughput, query latency and GPU memory on this workstation. Product hits remain unscored suggestions pointing to the original.
